title: Independent backups and restoration
acceptance_scenarios: Restore DB plus all files into isolated staging with outbound jobs disabled. Reconcile counts/checksums, recover encrypted content, measure agreed RPO/RTO and test failed-job alerting.
evidence_after_implementation: A14-backup-policy.pdf; redacted job/storage metadata; A14-restore-reconciliation.csv; timed restore-report.pdf; alert results and operator/reviewer approvals.
manual_acceptance: Infrastructure and custodian witness recovery; confirm independent storage and lawful retention. Run scheduled restore exercises and after material architecture/key changes. Job success alone does not prove recoverability.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
implemented_controls: Existing database-plus-filestore backups use streamed authenticated encryption, external key and artifact digests. Restore validates both artifacts and rejects unsafe archive members. Restored cron/mail COPY rows are neutralised before atomic schema publication. Registered legacy pairs are migrated explicitly.
remaining_actions: Independent/off-host storage, independent key escrow, agreed RPO/RTO, backup retention and periodic witnessed restore schedules remain operational tasks.
